minutes.headline: Selectmen suspended J&M Sports Bar's liquor license for seven days after a second violation; skate park backed in principle.
minutes.summary: The board held a liquor license hearing, found an after-hours violation, and set a seven-day suspension. Seventh-grade students presented a skate park proposal and the board voted to support it in principle, with the site to be chosen from three options. The board also ratified a reserve police officer, heard a long town manager report, and agreed to drop the selectmen stipend from the next budget.

Said the School Committee meeting was canceled and the committee will get the skate park report; asked about the cost of building on flat land versus into the hill.

what_happened.line: The Select Board found a liquor license violation at J&M Sports Bar and voted to suspend the license for seven days, April 8 to April 14.
The board voted to support a student skate park proposal in principle, with the site to be chosen from three options.
The board ratified the town manager's appointment of a reserve police officer; the full-time officer appointment was postponed to March 20.
The board agreed the town manager should remove the selectmen stipend from the next budget unless a reason is found; the vote was not audible in the recording.
The town manager was told to hold warrant payments tied to unresolved high school and middle school HVAC and ceiling work.

why_it_matters: The skate park has no site, design or cost yet, so any spending would come later through capital planning and could reach residents as a Town Meeting vote.
Holding payments on unfinished school building work keeps town money from going out until the work is resolved, and the stipend change slightly trims the next budget.
watch_next: The March 20 Select Board meeting, where the full-time police officer appointment is due.
Design work and cost estimates for the skate park, which come before capital planning.

reconciliation.summary: The records agree on the liquor hearing votes, the license renewal, the police officer postponement and most figures, with several caption misspellings of names and amounts. The main difference is that the official minutes record the selectmen stipend elimination as passing unanimously, and give no outcome for the skate park motion, while our recording had both as not audible or unclear.
